name: csv-summarizer
description: Analyzes CSV files and generates basic statistical summaries using standard library only
args: import csv, json, sys; data = []; with open(sys.argv[1], 'r') as f: reader = csv.DictReader(f); data = list(reader); print(json.dumps({'rows': len(data), 'columns': len(data[0]) if data else 0, 'column_names': list(data[0].keys()) if data else []}))
